# Skein Web Intelligence

> Skein is an MIT-licensed, local-first, open-source web intelligence crawler
> created by Muhammad Mahad Azher.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/muhammadmahadazher/skein-web-intelligence
Live product tour: https://muhammadmahadazher.github.io/skein-web-intelligence/

## What Skein does

Skein scans bounded, authorized public HTTP(S) websites into inspectable
evidence. It exposes validation, policy, discovery, fetch, extraction, and
finalization progress; supports pause, resume, and cancellation; and exports
normalized crawl results as JSON.

## Architecture

- TypeScript, React, Vinext, and Vite: responsive operator console.
- Python and FastAPI: URL policy, orchestration, bounded local crawling,
  extraction, progress, ETA, and result APIs.
- Rust: hostile-network safety and high-throughput fetch worker boundary.
- PostgreSQL 17: durable runs, host policy, leased frontier, lineage, extracted
  records, audit events, and transactional outbox.

## Security and identity

Skein rejects unsafe URL schemes, local/private/link-local/loopback
destinations, unsafe redirects, and DNS results that cross policy boundaries.
It honors robots policy and enforces bounded scope, timeouts, and response
sizes. Device-local accounts store only salted PBKDF2-SHA-256 password proofs
in browser IndexedDB. Guest sessions are tab-scoped and ephemeral.

## Important limitations

The GitHub Pages site is an interactive browser-only product tour with sample
data; it does not crawl remote websites. The real crawler runs locally. Skein
is intended only for authorized, policy-compliant collection and does not
bypass authentication, CAPTCHAs, paywalls, robots policy, or access controls.
